name: Constant Recovery puts Recovering on the ally Reverse Wound heals (#1986)
contract: Constant Recovery 555729 effect 1 is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Recovering 680843 - aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT with EffectBasePoints 5 (die 1 => +6%), DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, implicit target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY - but Spell.dbc gives 555729 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so Recovering never landed. With a row keyed on the heal done by Reverse Wound 801303 (family 28, word1 0x20000 and word2 0x1), one Reverse Wound on a wounded ally must place Recovering on that ally, cast by the Chronomancer, with an amount of 6. AuraEffect::HandleProcTriggerSpellAuraProc sends the trigger to the event's action target, which is the healed ally. Effect 0 (aura 10 SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT, EffectMiscValue 2, EffectBasePoints -21) already works through AuraEffect::HandleModThreat and is excluded from the proc by DisableEffectsMask 1; it is not the reported defect and is not asserted here.

steps.label: Reverse Wound's heal places Recovering on the ally
Recovering carries the record's 6% healing taken
